full_prompt_en: This is a square monochrome digital illustration built from four overlapping male faces and shoulders against a near-black field. The background contains irregular black and charcoal areas crossed by jagged white streaks, thin contours and scattered flecks. There is no distinct setting or readable lettering. The largest face sits in the upper-right, turned in profile toward the right edge. Thick pale hair sweeps backward from the brow, and a full white beard extends below the jaw. A dark oval covering hides one eye, while the other side of the face and the bridge of the nose are traced with grey highlights. His enlarged profile is cropped at the top and right, making it dominate the composition. At the centre foreground, a dark-haired bearded man faces outward with a stern, focused gaze. Loose strands fall across his forehead, and his dark beard contrasts with broad white lapels and a shadowed inner collar. Behind him at upper-left, a smaller short-haired man turns toward the right, his light face and dark jacket partly lost against the black ground. Near the lower-left, another pale-haired man appears in a smaller three-quarter view, his light shirt and jacket forming a narrow bright shape. The four figures overlap at different scales; the central face and giant side profile remain the strongest forms. Fine etched strokes describe hair, beard, fabric and facial planes, especially where pale forms meet the black field. The palette is restricted to white, silver-grey and charcoal, with small mid-grey transitions giving the faces depth. At the lower edge, a hand and dark object are partly cropped and obscured, so their exact forms remain unclear. Stylised upper-side light picks out brows, noses, cheekbones and pale hair, while broad white clothing planes contrast with dark inner folds and the solid black background. The stark value contrast and layered scales bring the faces forward without adding a separate environment. The overall composition concentrates four overlapping figures around the foreground gaze, using etched monochrome detail and a field of deep black to create a grave, graphic intensity.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白数码插画，四张男性面孔和肩部相互叠压在近乎全黑的底色上。背景是不规则黑色和炭灰色块，交错着锯齿白色线痕、纤细轮廓与零散亮点。没有明确环境或可读文字。最大的面孔位于右上，以侧面朝向右缘。浓密浅色头发从额头向后梳起，蓬松白胡须从下颌延伸。一个深色椭圆遮住一只眼，面部另一侧和鼻梁由灰色亮痕勾出。放大的侧脸在上缘与右侧被紧密裁切，成为画面主体。中央前景是一名深发留须男子，正面凝视，神情严肃专注。散发垂在额头，深色胡须对照宽阔白色翻领与阴影中的内领。左上后方，一名短发男子较小，头转向右侧，浅色面孔与深色外套部分融入黑底。左下附近还有一名浅发男子以较小的四分之三侧面出现，浅色衬衫与外套构成窄长亮形。四个人物以不同尺度彼此交叠；中央面孔与巨大的侧脸构成最醒目的形体。细密蚀刻般笔线刻画头发、胡须、织物和面部转折，浅色形体与黑底相接处尤其清楚。配色仅有白色、银灰和炭灰，少量中灰过渡为面孔增加纵深。下缘有一只手和深色物件被部分裁切、遮挡，具体形状无法辨认。风格化斜上方光提亮眉眼、鼻梁、颧骨与浅发，宽阔白色衣面则对照内部暗褶和实黑背景。强烈明暗反差和层叠尺度将面孔推到前景，却没有加入独立环境。整体构图把四张相叠面孔围绕前景凝视集中，以蚀刻式单色细节和深黑底色营造庄重而图形化的张力。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome digital treatment combines etched linework, selective soft shading and large areas of near-black. White and silver-grey highlights define focal edges, while mid-grey transitions give forms measured depth without flattening their silhouettes. Fine strokes gather around complex contours and thin out across quieter regions, while jagged light streaks cut through the darkest spaces. Overlapping scales create hierarchy, and abrupt shifts from dark field to pale form concentrate attention. The composition feels severe and graphic, with texture carried by line density and tonal contrast rather than colour.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白数码表现结合蚀刻式线条、选择性柔和明暗和大面积近黑色。白色与银灰亮部勾出焦点边缘，中灰过渡为形体增加适度纵深，同时保留清楚剪影。复杂轮廓附近细线密集，较安静区域则逐渐疏朗，锯齿状浅色笔痕穿过最暗空间。不同尺度的叠压建立层级，暗底与浅色形体的骤然转换集中注意力。整体严峻而图形化，质感主要来自线条疏密和明暗反差，而非色彩。
theme_en: Four overlapping monochrome male faces at different scales, with the largest bearded profile cropped along the upper right
theme_zh: 四张不同尺度的黑白男性面孔彼此叠压，右上方是被紧密裁切的巨大胡须侧脸
name: Metal Gear Solid
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
